name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.6 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 5 visits over 64 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 24 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.3 days starting 2026-01-05, at wavelengths from 0.79 to 4.18 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
